title: Thirty Years and One Loose Door
subtitle: 居家收纳 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 居家收纳（生活与学习·居家生活与收纳）
meta: 主题语境：居家收纳（生活与学习·居家生活与收纳）　|　核心词汇：cupboard　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cupboard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my grandmother ① fitted a cupboard that no carpenter in the town would have copied, and she said the fitting was the whole of the housekeeping. The ② cupboard, meaning the storing and not the furniture, ran thirty years and stayed unlocked; a cupboard, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how long it is left open.

Every ③ cupboard in that house had the same loose door against it, and the ④ cupboard at the end, meaning the one she kept for the winter stores and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted twice. A cupboard, my mother said, is nine parts order and one part somebody willing to tidy; my grandmother said the tidying is the part that fills thirty years.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the cupboard was the whole of the wall, meaning the fixture and not the storing. The ⑥ cupboard, meaning the fixture and not any of that, is the only thing on a wall that everybody measures and nobody empties; cupboard, he said, is either something you fit or the only word that means both a storing and a fixture. He said the fixture is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ cupboard had become a line in an inventory, and the inventory had become an argument about the loose door. The ⑧ cupboard of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in February, was one kitchen and thirty years of tidying; cupboard, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to tidy. She said the tidying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cupboard I remember is the one at the end, which was emptied in 1982 and is still described as the deepest in the county. A ⑩ cupboard, my grandmother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being tidied; every cupboard, she said, is a fixture that has agreed to look like a storing. She said the fixture was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 橱柜；碗柜（指靠墙立着的那一个）
B. n. 橱柜（指收纳这件事本身，与那件家具相对）
C. 固定搭配：fit a cupboard 安装（打制）一只橱柜
D. n. 橱柜（指存放越冬食物的那一只）
E. n. 橱柜；收纳（抽象总称，指一屋子的收拾之道）
F. n. 橱柜（指清单上写到、被登记的那一个）
G. n. 橱柜（指整面墙上的固定装置）
H. n. 固定装置（抽象总称，指被丈量的那件嵌入式家具）

items.q: fitted a cupboard that no carpenter in the town would have copied
The cupboard, meaning the storing and not the furniture

answers.why: fit a cupboard 意为“安装（打制）一只橱柜”，1952 年祖母打了一只全镇没有一位木匠肯照着做的橱柜。
cupboard 意为“橱柜”，指收纳这件事本身而不是那件家具，它三十年不上锁地立着。
cupboard 意为“橱柜”，指那栋房子里每一只橱柜，每一只都有同一扇松动的门。
cupboard 意为“橱柜”，指存放越冬食物的那一只，是唯一有人清点过两次的。
cupboard 意为“橱柜”，指整面墙上的固定装置，父亲说这只橱柜就是那面墙的全部。
cupboard 意为“固定装置”，指被丈量的那件嵌入式家具而不是别的，是墙面上人人都量、却无人清空的东西。
cupboard 意为“橱柜”，指清单上写到、被登记的那一个，到 1966 年这只橱柜成了清单里的一行。
cupboard 意为“橱柜、收纳”，祖母二月写道，整件事的收纳是一只橱柜和三十年的收拾。
cupboard 意为“橱柜”，我记得的是末尾那一只，1982 年被清空，至今仍被说成全县最深的。
cupboard 为抽象总称，祖母 1984 年说，一只橱柜是唯一会因为被收拾而变得更好的东西。
